scope: real Ubuntu/ext4 held-descriptor writes across lazy detach; synthetic disposable image only

harness.warning: Bound to the named disposable VPS image and mount path; do not run against other storage.

lab_setup.uuid_probe: A temporary read ACL for user brain was applied only to the exact disposable /dev/loop1 block node after root pinned major:minor and UUID; the existing unprivileged LinuxExt4VolumeProbe then returned the matching UUID.

post_test_probe.procedure: After removing the ACL and UUID link, invalidate the blkid cache, unmount and remount the same loop image, then wait for the normal udev settle event.
post_test_probe.result: The existing unprivileged LinuxExt4VolumeProbe returned the exact UUID with no ACL and brain was not a member of disk.
post_test_probe.uuid_link: udev recreated the UUID link targeting /dev/loop1

interpretation.mkdir_create_and_atomic_rename: completed using the held descriptor after lazy detach; each result was read back from the original ext4 image after remount
interpretation.append_open: rejected with mountpoint_directory_fallback; pre-existing file content matched after remount
interpretation.precheck: detaching before revalidation failed closed before the forbidden write
interpretation.qualification_limit: These exact DescriptorWriter operations on this Ubuntu/ext4 synthetic loop image only. This does not qualify arbitrary writers, real research data, provider dispatch, crash durability, or identity continuity across remounts.
